defects.issue: Height label was partly clipped by the apparatus clip path.
defects.fix: Keep the height annotation outside the cropped apparatus group.

defects.issue: Newly enabled controls temporarily inherited intermediate disabled opacity, giving 4.04 to 4.23 text contrast.
defects.fix: Transition only background, border and shadow; enabled text becomes fully opaque immediately.

defects.issue: Comparison curve labels and lines were faded until difficult to read.
defects.fix: Keep labels opaque and distinguish comparison curves with dashes instead of low opacity.

defects.issue: Dimers and comparison curves had low visual contrast.
defects.fix: Use outlined colourless dimers, a visible vessel boundary and opaque distinct curves.

auditChange: Inspect partial text clipping inside an ancestor clip path, as well as the outer SVG boundary. Completely clipped microscope reticle labels outside the eyepiece are not visible and are excluded; the initial 0/100 reticle reports were false positives.

validation.status: Passed: both engines, 2810 structural diagram states each; final 65 focused reading states each; label contrast at least 4.45:1 and curve contrast at least 3:1 in the five-app regression; completed comparison controls also passed the full HTML contrast scan.
